fields.description: Statistical measures comparing the probability of a health outcome between exposed and unexposed groups, used to quantify the strength of association between an exposure and an outcome.

fields.name: dsny000287_sub|0
fields.title: Emergency department visit (Metric)
fields.description: The rate or number of attendances at emergency departments for acute assessment and treatment, used as an indicator of urgent health need.

fields.name: dsny000287_sub|1
fields.title: Healthcare access disruption (Metric)
fields.description: Interruptions to the availability or accessibility of healthcare services, resulting in delayed, reduced, or foregone care for affected populations.

fields.name: dsny000287_sub|2
fields.title: Hospital admission (Metric)
fields.description: The rate or number of patients admitted to hospital as inpatients for treatment, observation, or care related to a specific condition.

fields.name: dsny000287_sub|3
fields.title: Length of hospital stay (Metric)
fields.description: The duration of an inpatient hospital episode, used as a measure of disease severity, healthcare resource use, and patient recovery.

fields.name: dsny000287_sub|4
fields.title: Outpatient / primary care visit (Metric)
fields.description: The rate or number of non-emergency contacts with primary care or outpatient services, including general practice, specialist clinics, and community health settings.

fields.name: k_health-outcomes|0
fields.title: N.3.1 Mortality
fields.description: The occurrence of death as a health outcome, classified by cause, age group, and population to characterise the fatal burden of disease.

fields.name: k_health-outcomes|1
fields.title: N.3.2 Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional diseases
fields.description: The broad category of diseases caused by infectious agents or related to maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions, as defined in the GBD cause hierarchy.

fields.name: k_health-outcomes|2
fields.title: N.3.3 Non-communicable diseases
fields.description: Chronic, non-infectious diseases of long duration including cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic, neurological, and neoplastic conditions.

fields.name: k_health-outcomes|3
fields.title: N.3.4 Injuries
fields.description: Physical harm to the body resulting from external causes, including unintentional injuries, self-harm, interpersonal violence, and conflict.

fields.name: dsny000296_sub|0
fields.title: Communicable, maternal, neonatal, and nutritional mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to communicable diseases, maternal conditions, neonatal disorders, and nutritional deficiencies.

fields.name: dsny000296_sub|1
fields.title: Non-communicable mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to non-communicable diseases, including cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic, and neoplastic conditions.

fields.name: dsny000296_sub|2
fields.title: Total / all-cause mortality (Outcome)
fields.description: Deaths from any cause combined, used as an overall measure of fatal burden without attribution to a specific disease or condition.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|0
fields.title: Infectious diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths caused by infectious and parasitic diseases, including respiratory, enteric, vector-borne, and other infections.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|1
fields.title: Maternal mortality
fields.description: Deaths among women during pregnancy, childbirth, or the postpartum period attributable to obstetric causes.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|2
fields.title: Neonatal mortality
fields.description: Deaths occurring in the first 28 days of life, attributable to preterm birth, birth asphyxia, neonatal infection, and congenital conditions.

fields.name: dsny000305_sub|3
fields.title: Nutrition-related mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to nutritional deficiencies and undernutrition, including protein-energy malnutrition and micronutrient deficiency disorders.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|0
fields.title: Enteric infections mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to enteric infections transmitted via contaminated food or water, including diarrhoeal diseases and typhoid.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|1
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria mortality
fields.description: Deaths caused by neglected tropical diseases and malaria, disproportionately affecting populations in low-income tropical settings.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|2
fields.title: Other infectious diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths from infectious diseases not classified under respiratory, enteric, or vector-borne categories, including meningitis, encephalitis, and vaccine-preventable infections.

fields.name: dsny000306_sub|3
fields.title: Respiratory infections mortality (including tuberculosis)
fields.description: Deaths caused by infections of the respiratory tract, including tuberculosis, pneumonia, and other lower and upper respiratory infections.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|0
fields.title: Cardiovascular mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to diseases of the heart and circulatory system, including ischemic heart disease, stroke, and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|1
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to chronic conditions of the respiratory tract, including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|2
fields.title: Diabetes and kidney diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease, which frequently co-occur and share common risk pathways.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|3
fields.title: Injury-related mortality (drowning, fires, disasters, suicide, violence)
fields.description: Deaths resulting from injuries including drowning, fires, natural disasters, suicide, and interpersonal violence.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|4
fields.title: Neoplasms mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to malignant and benign neoplasms across all anatomical sites.

fields.name: dsny000298_sub|5
fields.title: Other non-communicable diseases mortality
fields.description: Deaths attributable to non-communicable diseases not classified under the major NCD categories of cardiovascular, respiratory, neoplastic, or metabolic disease.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|0
fields.title: Enteric infections
fields.description: Infections of the gastrointestinal tract transmitted via contaminated food or water, including diarrhoeal diseases, typhoid, and cholera.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|1
fields.title: HIV/AIDS and sexually transmitted infections
fields.description: Infections transmitted through sexual contact or blood-borne routes, including HIV/AIDS and bacterial and viral sexually transmitted infections.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|2
fields.title: Maternal and neonatal disorders
fields.description: Conditions arising during pregnancy, childbirth, or the neonatal period, including obstetric complications and disorders of the newborn.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|3
fields.title: Neglected tropical diseases and malaria
fields.description: A diverse group of infectious diseases that disproportionately affect populations in tropical and subtropical low-income settings, including parasitic, bacterial, and viral conditions.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|4
fields.title: Nutritional deficiencies
fields.description: Conditions arising from insufficient intake of macro- or micronutrients, including protein-energy malnutrition and deficiencies in key vitamins and minerals.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|5
fields.title: Respiratory infections and tuberculosis
fields.description: Acute and chronic infections of the respiratory tract, including tuberculosis, pneumonia, and upper respiratory infections.

fields.name: dsny000314_sub|6
fields.title: Z_Other infectious diseases
fields.description: Infectious diseases not classified under respiratory, enteric, or vector-borne categories, including bacterial, viral, and prion conditions of diverse transmission routes.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|0
fields.title: Diarrheal diseases
fields.description: Illness characterised by loose or watery stools, caused by a range of enteric pathogens and strongly associated with unsafe water, poor sanitation, and food contamination.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|1
fields.title: Invasive Non-typhoidal Salmonella (iNTS)
fields.description: Severe systemic infection caused by non-typhoidal Salmonella serovars invading the bloodstream, predominantly affecting young children and immunocompromised individuals in low-income settings.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|2
fields.title: Typhoid and paratyphoid
fields.description: Systemic bacterial infections caused by Salmonella Typhi and Salmonella Paratyphi, transmitted via contaminated food and water.

fields.name: dsny000324_sub|3
fields.title: Z_Other intestinal infectious diseases
fields.description: Intestinal infectious diseases not classified under diarrhoea, cholera, typhoid, or iNTS, including other bacterial, viral, and parasitic gut infections.

fields.name: dsny000325_sub|0
fields.title: Cholera
fields.description: An acute diarrhoeal illness caused by the bacterium Vibrio cholerae, typically transmitted through contaminated water and capable of causing rapid dehydration and death.

fields.name: dsny000315_sub|0
fields.title: HIV/AIDS
fields.description: Infection caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), which progressively damages the immune system and, without treatment, leads to acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

fields.name: dsny000315_sub|1
fields.title: Sexually transmitted infections excluding HIV
fields.description: Infections transmitted primarily through sexual contact, excluding HIV, including syphilis, gonorrhoea, chlamydia, and other sexually transmitted pathogens.

fields.name: dsny000364_sub|0
fields.title: Maternal disorders
fields.description: Medical conditions and complications directly related to pregnancy and childbirth, including haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, obstructed labour, and sepsis.

fields.name: dsny000364_sub|1
fields.title: Neonatal disorders
fields.description: Conditions originating in the perinatal period affecting newborns, including preterm birth, birth asphyxia, neonatal infections, and congenital anomalies.

fields.name: dsny000365_sub|0
fields.title: Maternal abortion and miscarriage
fields.description: The spontaneous or induced termination of pregnancy before viability, including miscarriage, unsafe abortion, and related complications.

fields.name: dsny000367_sub|0
fields.title: Low birth weight
fields.description: Birth weight below 2,500 grams, associated with increased neonatal mortality, infection susceptibility, and long-term developmental and metabolic risk.

fields.name: dsny000367_sub|1
fields.title: Neonatal preterm birth
fields.description: Birth occurring before 37 completed weeks of gestation, associated with increased risk of respiratory distress, infection, neurodevelopmental impairment, and neonatal death.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|0
fields.title: African trypanosomiasis
fields.description: A vector-borne parasitic disease caused by Trypanosoma brucei, transmitted by tsetse flies, causing progressive neurological deterioration if untreated.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|1
fields.title: Chagas disease
fields.description: A vector-borne parasitic disease caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, transmitted by triatomine bugs and endemic to Latin America, with chronic cardiac and digestive complications.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|2
fields.title: Chikungunya
fields.description: A mosquito-borne viral disease transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, causing acute fever and severe joint pain that can persist for months.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|3
fields.title: Cystic echinococcosis
fields.description: A zoonotic parasitic disease caused by the larval stage of Echinococcus granulosus tapeworm, producing fluid-filled cysts predominantly in the liver and lungs.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|4
fields.title: Cysticercosis
fields.description: Infection by the larval stage of the pork tapeworm Taenia solium, which can invade the brain causing neurocysticercosis, a leading cause of acquired epilepsy.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|5
fields.title: Dengue
fields.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection caused by dengue virus serotypes, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, producing fever, severe headache, and in severe cases haemorrhagic complications.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|6
fields.title: Ebola
fields.description: A severe and often fatal viral haemorrhagic fever caused by Ebola virus, characterised by fever, bleeding, and multi-organ failure.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|7
fields.title: Food-borne trematodiases
fields.description: Parasitic infections caused by trematode flatworms acquired through consumption of contaminated raw or undercooked fish, crustaceans, or aquatic plants.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|8
fields.title: Guinea worm disease
fields.description: A parasitic infection caused by Dracunculus medinensis, acquired by drinking water containing infected copepods, resulting in a slowly emerging worm through the skin.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|9
fields.title: Intestinal nematode infections
fields.description: Parasitic worm infections transmitted through soil contaminated with faecal matter, including ascariasis, hookworm, and trichuriasis, causing malnutrition and developmental impairment.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|10
fields.title: Leishmaniasis
fields.description: A parasitic disease caused by Leishmania species, transmitted by sandflies, presenting as cutaneous, mucocutaneous, or visceral forms.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|11
fields.title: Leprosy
fields.description: A chronic bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium leprae, affecting the skin, peripheral nerves, and mucous membranes, and historically associated with significant stigma.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|12
fields.title: Leptospirosis
fields.description: A bacterial zoonosis caused by Leptospira species, transmitted through contact with water or soil contaminated by infected animal urine, with risk elevated during flooding events.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|13
fields.title: Lymphatic filariasis
fields.description: A mosquito-transmitted parasitic disease caused by filarial worms, leading to lymphatic damage, lymphoedema, and disfiguring swelling of the limbs and genitals.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|14
fields.title: Malaria
fields.description: A parasitic disease transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, caused by Plasmodium species, producing fever, anaemia, and potentially fatal cerebral complications.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|15
fields.title: Onchocerciasis
fields.description: A parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus, transmitted by blackflies near fast-flowing rivers, causing skin disease and progressive visual impairment leading to blindness.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|16
fields.title: Rabies
fields.description: A fatal viral encephalitis caused by lyssavirus, transmitted through the bite of infected animals, almost universally fatal once clinical symptoms develop.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|17
fields.title: Schistosomiasis
fields.description: A parasitic disease caused by Schistosoma flatworms, transmitted through contact with contaminated freshwater, causing chronic inflammation of the bladder, liver, and intestines.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|18
fields.title: Trachoma
fields.description: A chronic bacterial eye infection caused by Chlamydia trachomatis, the leading infectious cause of preventable blindness worldwide.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|19
fields.title: Yellow fever
fields.description: An acute viral haemorrhagic disease transmitted by Aedes and Haemagogus mosquitoes, endemic in tropical Africa and South America.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|20
fields.title: Zika virus
fields.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection caused by Zika virus, typically mild in adults but associated with congenital microcephaly and Guillain-Barré syndrome.

fields.name: dsny000330_sub|21
fields.title: Zz_Other neglected tropical diseases
fields.description: Neglected tropical diseases not classified under specific GBD sub-categories, including other parasitic and bacterial infections endemic to tropical regions.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|0
fields.title: Childhood stunting and wasting
fields.description: Growth faltering in children due to chronic undernutrition (stunting: low height-for-age) or acute undernutrition (wasting: low weight-for-height), with serious consequences for development and survival.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|1
fields.title: Dietary iron deficiency
fields.description: Insufficient dietary iron intake leading to iron deficiency anaemia, impairing oxygen transport, cognitive development, and immune function.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|2
fields.title: Iodine deficiency
fields.description: Conditions resulting from insufficient dietary iodine, including goitre, hypothyroidism, and cretinism, with adverse effects on thyroid function and neurodevelopment.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|3
fields.title: Protein-energy malnutrition
fields.description: Severe deficiency of protein and energy intake, manifesting as marasmus (energy deficiency) or kwashiorkor (protein deficiency), predominantly affecting young children in food-insecure settings.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|4
fields.title: Vitamin A deficiency
fields.description: Deficiency of vitamin A resulting in night blindness, increased susceptibility to infection, and xerophthalmia, predominantly affecting children and pregnant women.

fields.name: dsny000370_sub|5
fields.title: Z_Other nutritional deficiencies
fields.description: Nutritional deficiency conditions not elsewhere classified, including deficiencies in zinc, folate, calcium, and other micronutrients essential for health.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|0
fields.title: COVID-19
fields.description: Respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, ranging from mild infection to severe pneumonia, acute respiratory distress, and multi-organ failure.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|1
fields.title: Lower respiratory infections
fields.description: Infections of the lower respiratory tract including the lungs and bronchi, such as pneumonia and bronchiolitis, representing a leading cause of morbidity and mortality.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|2
fields.title: Otitis media
fields.description: Infection and inflammation of the middle ear, commonly caused by bacterial or viral pathogens following upper respiratory infection.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|3
fields.title: Tuberculosis
fields.description: A chronic bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs but capable of affecting any organ system.

fields.name: dsny000318_sub|4
fields.title: Upper respiratory infections
fields.description: Infections of the upper respiratory tract including the nose, throat, sinuses, and larynx, typically caused by viruses.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|0
fields.title: Acute hepatitis
fields.description: Acute inflammatory liver disease caused by hepatitis A, B, C, D, or E viruses, ranging from self-limiting illness to fulminant hepatic failure.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|1
fields.title: Diphtheria
fields.description: A vaccine-preventable bacterial infection caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, producing a toxin that causes a characteristic pharyngeal membrane and life-threatening airway obstruction and cardiac complications.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|2
fields.title: Encephalitis
fields.description: Inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral, bacterial, or autoimmune processes, presenting with altered consciousness, seizures, and focal neurological signs.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|3
fields.title: Lyme disease
fields.description: A tick-borne bacterial infection caused by Borrelia burgdorferi, presenting with a characteristic expanding rash and potentially causing cardiac, neurological, and joint complications if untreated.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|4
fields.title: Measles
fields.description: A highly contagious viral infection caused by measles morbillivirus, preventable by vaccination and causing fever, rash, and serious complications including pneumonia and encephalitis.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|5
fields.title: Meningitis
fields.description: Inflammation of the meninges caused by bacterial, viral, or fungal pathogens, presenting with fever, headache, and neck stiffness and potentially fatal if untreated.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|6
fields.title: Pertussis
fields.description: A highly contagious bacterial respiratory infection caused by Bordetella pertussis, characterised by severe paroxysmal coughing and particularly dangerous in infants.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|7
fields.title: Tetanus
fields.description: A bacterial infection caused by Clostridium tetani toxin, producing painful muscle spasms and rigidity, with neonatal tetanus a particular risk in low-income settings.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|8
fields.title: Varicella and herpes zoster
fields.description: Infection caused by varicella-zoster virus, producing chickenpox on primary infection and reactivating as herpes zoster (shingles) in older or immunocompromised individuals.

fields.name: dsny000353_sub|9
fields.title: Z_Other unspecified infectious diseases
fields.description: Infectious diseases not elsewhere classified, including rare, emerging, or unspecified infections not captured in major GBD sub-categories.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|0
fields.title: Cardiovascular diseases
fields.description: Diseases of the heart and blood vessels, including ischemic heart disease, stroke, heart failure, and other circulatory conditions.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|1
fields.title: Chronic respiratory diseases
fields.description: Long-term diseases affecting the airways and lung parenchyma, including obstructive, restrictive, and inflammatory conditions causing progressive respiratory impairment.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|2
fields.title: Diabetes and kidney diseases
fields.description: A GBD grouping encompassing diabetes mellitus and kidney diseases, which share common metabolic risk factors and frequently co-occur.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|3
fields.title: Digestive diseases
fields.description: Non-infectious diseases of the gastrointestinal tract and related organs, including the liver, gallbladder, and pancreas.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|4
fields.title: Mental disorders
fields.description: Conditions characterised by clinically significant disturbances in cognition, emotion regulation, or behaviour, reflecting dysfunction in psychological or biological processes.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|5
fields.title: Musculoskeletal disorders
fields.description: Diseases of bones, joints, muscles, and connective tissue, including osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, osteoporosis, and low back and neck pain.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|6
fields.title: Neoplasms
fields.description: Diseases characterised by the uncontrolled growth of abnormal cells, including malignant cancers and benign tumours across all anatomical sites.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|7
fields.title: Neurological disorders
fields.description: Diseases affecting the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nervous system, including degenerative, inflammatory, and functional neurological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|8
fields.title: Sense organ diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the organs of vision and hearing, including conditions causing visual impairment, blindness, and hearing loss.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|9
fields.title: Skin and subcutaneous diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the skin and subcutaneous tissue, including inflammatory, infectious, allergic, and degenerative conditions.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|10
fields.title: Substance use disorders
fields.description: Disorders characterised by compulsive use of psychoactive substances despite adverse consequences, including alcohol and drug use disorders.

fields.name: dsny000377_sub|11
fields.title: Z_Other non-communicable diseases
fields.description: Non-communicable diseases not classified under the major GBD NCD categories, including congenital, genitourinary, haematological, and other miscellaneous conditions.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|0
fields.title: Aortic aneurysm
fields.description: Pathological dilation of the aortic wall with risk of rupture, most commonly involving the abdominal aorta and associated with hypertension and atherosclerosis.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|1
fields.title: Atrial fibrillation and flutter
fields.description: Cardiac arrhythmias characterised by rapid and irregular electrical activity in the atria, associated with stroke risk and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|2
fields.title: Cardiomyopathy and myocarditis
fields.description: Diseases of the heart muscle including cardiomyopathy and inflammation of the myocardium, leading to impaired cardiac function and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|3
fields.title: Endocarditis
fields.description: Infection of the endocardium, most commonly involving the heart valves, caused by bacterial or fungal organisms and associated with significant morbidity and mortality.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|4
fields.title: Hypertensive heart disease
fields.description: Structural and functional cardiac disease caused by chronic elevation of blood pressure, leading to left ventricular hypertrophy and heart failure.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|5
fields.title: Ischemic heart disease
fields.description: Reduction in blood supply to the heart muscle due to atherosclerosis of the coronary arteries, presenting as angina, myocardial infarction, or sudden cardiac death.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|6
fields.title: Lower extremity peripheral arterial disease
fields.description: Atherosclerotic obstruction of the arteries supplying the lower limbs, causing claudication, ischaemia, and risk of amputation.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|7
fields.title: Non-rheumatic valvular heart disease
fields.description: Dysfunction of one or more heart valves not attributable to rheumatic disease, including aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, and degenerative valve conditions.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|8
fields.title: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
fields.description: Elevated blood pressure in the pulmonary arterial circulation leading to progressive right heart failure and exercise limitation.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|9
fields.title: Rheumatic heart disease
fields.description: Cardiac valve damage resulting from repeated episodes of rheumatic fever caused by group A streptococcal throat infection, predominantly affecting children and young adults in low-income settings.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|10
fields.title: Stroke
fields.description: Sudden interruption or rupture of blood supply to the brain, causing focal neurological deficits, classified as ischaemic or haemorrhagic in type.

fields.name: dsny000384_sub|11
fields.title: Z_Other cardiovascular and circulatory diseases
fields.description: Cardiovascular and circulatory diseases not elsewhere classified in the GBD framework, including peripheral vascular conditions and miscellaneous cardiac disorders.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|0
fields.title: Allergic rhinitis
fields.description: Allergic inflammation of the nasal mucosa triggered by inhaled allergens including pollen, dust mites, and moulds, causing sneezing, nasal congestion, and rhinorrhoea.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|1
fields.title: Asthma
fields.description: A chronic inflammatory airway disease characterised by reversible bronchoconstriction, wheeze, and airway hyperresponsiveness, triggered by allergens, pollutants, and respiratory infections.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|2
fields.title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
fields.description: A progressive, non-reversible obstructive lung disease characterised by persistent airflow limitation, associated with tobacco smoke, indoor and outdoor air pollution, and occupational exposures.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|3
fields.title: Interstitial lung disease and pulmonary sarcoidosis
fields.description: A heterogeneous group of diffuse parenchymal lung diseases characterised by inflammation and fibrosis of the lung interstitium, leading to progressive breathlessness and impaired gas exchange.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|4
fields.title: Pneumoconiosis
fields.description: Occupational lung diseases caused by chronic inhalation of mineral or organic dusts, including silicosis, coal workers pneumoconiosis, and asbestosis.

fields.name: dsny000397_sub|5
fields.title: Z_Other chronic respiratory diseases
fields.description: Chronic respiratory diseases not captured under the specific GBD sub-categories of COPD, pneumoconiosis, asthma, or interstitial lung disease.

fields.name: dsny000438_sub|0
fields.title: Acute glomerulonephritis
fields.description: Acute inflammatory disease of the glomeruli, typically immune-mediated, presenting with haematuria, proteinuria, hypertension, and impaired renal function.

fields.name: dsny000438_sub|1
fields.title: Diabetes mellitus
fields.description: A group of metabolic diseases characterised by chronic hyperglycaemia resulting from defects in insulin secretion, insulin action, or both, with long-term damage to multiple organ systems.

fields.name: dsny000438_sub|2
fields.title: Kidney dysfunction
fields.description: Impaired kidney function assessed by reduced glomerular filtration rate or markers of renal damage, encompassing both chronic and acute kidney conditions.

fields.name: dsny000440_sub|0
fields.title: Acute kidney injury
fields.description: Sudden deterioration of kidney function over hours to days, causing accumulation of waste products and fluid imbalance, often associated with sepsis, dehydration, or nephrotoxic exposure.

fields.name: dsny000440_sub|1
fields.title: Chronic kidney disease
fields.description: Irreversible, progressive loss of kidney function over months to years, classified by stages of declining GFR and associated with cardiovascular risk and need for renal replacement therapy.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|0
fields.title: Appendicitis
fields.description: Acute inflammation of the appendix, presenting with right iliac fossa pain and requiring surgical intervention to prevent perforation and peritonitis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|1
fields.title: Cirrhosis and other chronic liver diseases
fields.description: Progressive scarring and fibrosis of the liver resulting from chronic injury, including viral hepatitis, alcohol use, and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, ultimately causing liver failure.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|2
fields.title: Gallbladder and biliary diseases
fields.description: Conditions affecting the gallbladder and bile ducts, including cholelithiasis, cholecystitis, and biliary obstruction.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|3
fields.title: Inflammatory bowel disease
fields.description: Chronic immune-mediated inflammatory conditions of the gastrointestinal tract, including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, characterised by relapsing intestinal inflammation.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|4
fields.title: Inguinal, femoral, and abdominal hernia
fields.description: Protrusion of abdominal contents through a weakness in the abdominal wall, including inguinal, femoral, and other hernias requiring surgical repair.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|5
fields.title: Pancreatitis
fields.description: Acute or chronic inflammation of the pancreas, causing abdominal pain and disrupting digestive enzyme and insulin secretion.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|6
fields.title: Paralytic ileus and intestinal obstruction
fields.description: Mechanical or functional obstruction of the intestine causing failure of intestinal transit, presenting with pain, distension, and vomiting.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|7
fields.title: Upper digestive system diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the oesophagus, stomach, and duodenum, including peptic ulcer disease, gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, and gastritis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|8
fields.title: Vascular intestinal disorders
fields.description: Conditions arising from impaired blood supply to the intestinal wall, including mesenteric ischaemia and ischaemic colitis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|9
fields.title: Z_Other digestive diseases
fields.description: Digestive diseases not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories of liver, upper GI, appendix, hernia, IBD, vascular, gallbladder, or pancreatic disease.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|0
fields.title: Anxiety disorders
fields.description: A group of mental disorders characterised by excessive fear or worry disproportionate to circumstances, including generalised anxiety disorder, panic disorder, and phobias.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|1
fields.title: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
fields.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by persistent inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that impairs functioning across multiple settings.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|2
fields.title: Autism spectrum disorders
fields.description: A neurodevelopmental condition characterised by persistent difficulties in social communication and interaction alongside restricted, repetitive patterns of behaviour.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|3
fields.title: Bipolar disorder
fields.description: A mood disorder characterised by episodes of mania or hypomania alternating with depression, causing significant disruption to functioning and quality of life.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|4
fields.title: Conduct disorder
fields.description: A disruptive behavioural disorder characterised by repetitive and persistent patterns of antisocial behaviour, aggression, or violation of social norms.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|5
fields.title: Depressive disorders
fields.description: A common mental disorder characterised by persistent low mood, anhedonia, and a range of cognitive, physical, and emotional symptoms causing significant functional impairment.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|6
fields.title: Eating disorders
fields.description: Mental disorders characterised by abnormal eating behaviours and distorted body image, including anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge eating disorder.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|7
fields.title: Idiopathic developmental intellectual disability
fields.description: Significantly impaired intellectual functioning and adaptive behaviour arising from neurodevelopmental causes, without an identifiable acquired or genetic aetiology.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|8
fields.title: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
fields.description: A trauma- and stressor-related disorder developing after exposure to actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence, characterised by intrusive symptoms, avoidance, and hyperarousal.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|9
fields.title: Schizophrenia
fields.description: A severe chronic mental disorder characterised by positive symptoms (hallucinations, delusions), negative symptoms (blunted affect, social withdrawal), and cognitive impairment.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|10
fields.title: Z_Other mental disorders
fields.description: Mental disorders not classified under the major GBD mental health sub-categories, including other anxiety, dissociative, somatic, and unspecified psychiatric conditions.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|0
fields.title: Malignant skin melanoma
fields.description: A malignant tumour arising from melanocytes in the skin, strongly associated with ultraviolet radiation exposure and with high metastatic potential.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|1
fields.title: Non-melanoma skin cancer
fields.description: Malignant tumours arising from keratinocytes in the skin, including basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, associated with cumulative UV radiation exposure.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|2
fields.title: Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer
fields.description: Malignant tumours arising in the trachea, bronchi, or lung parenchyma, strongly associated with tobacco smoking and air pollution exposure.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|3
fields.title: Z_Other malignant neoplasms
fields.description: Malignant neoplasms not classified under the specific GBD cancer sub-categories, spanning other primary tumour sites and histological types.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|4
fields.title: Z_Other neoplasms
fields.description: Non-malignant tumours that do not invade surrounding tissue or metastasise but may cause local symptoms through mass effect.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|0
fields.title: Alzheimer's disease and other dementias
fields.description: Progressive neurodegenerative diseases characterised by cognitive decline, including Alzheimer's disease and other dementias causing loss of memory, reasoning, and functional independence.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|1
fields.title: Headache disorders
fields.description: Chronic neurological disorders characterised by recurrent headache, including migraine, tension-type headache, and cluster headache, causing significant disability.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|2
fields.title: Idiopathic epilepsy
fields.description: A neurological disorder characterised by recurrent unprovoked seizures due to abnormal electrical activity in the brain, not attributable to an identified structural or metabolic cause.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|3
fields.title: Motor neuron disease
fields.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disease causing degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons, leading to progressive paralysis and respiratory failure.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|4
fields.title: Multiple sclerosis
fields.description: A chronic autoimmune demyelinating disease of the central nervous system, characterised by relapsing or progressive neurological deficits affecting motor, sensory, and cognitive function.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|5
fields.title: Parkinson's disease
fields.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disease characterised by tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia, and postural instability, caused by loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|6
fields.title: Z_Other neurological disorders
fields.description: Neurological conditions not classified under the major GBD neurological sub-categories, including rare and unspecified disorders of the nervous system.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|0
fields.title: Age-related and other hearing loss
fields.description: Partial or complete loss of hearing attributable to ageing, noise exposure, ototoxic medications, or other causes, affecting communication and quality of life.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|1
fields.title: Blindness and vision loss
fields.description: A spectrum of visual impairment ranging from reduced vision to complete blindness, caused by refractive errors, cataracts, glaucoma, macular degeneration, and infectious causes including trachoma.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|2
fields.title: Other sense organ diseases
fields.description: Sense organ diseases not classified under blindness and vision loss or hearing loss, including other ocular and otological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|0
fields.title: Acne vulgaris
fields.description: A chronic inflammatory disease of the pilosebaceous unit characterised by comedones, papules, pustules, and nodules, predominantly affecting the face and trunk.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|1
fields.title: Alopecia areata
fields.description: An autoimmune condition causing patchy non-scarring hair loss on the scalp or other hair-bearing areas, which may progress to total hair loss.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|2
fields.title: Bacterial skin diseases
fields.description: Bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissue, including cellulitis, impetigo, and erysipelas, caused predominantly by Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pyogenes.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|3
fields.title: Decubitus ulcer
fields.description: Localised skin and underlying tissue injury resulting from prolonged pressure or shear forces, typically over bony prominences in immobile patients.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|4
fields.title: Dermatitis
fields.description: Inflammatory skin conditions characterised by erythema, pruritus, and scaling, including atopic dermatitis and contact dermatitis.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|5
fields.title: Fungal skin diseases
fields.description: Skin infections caused by fungi including dermatophytes (tinea), yeasts (candidiasis), and moulds, particularly prevalent in hot and humid conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|6
fields.title: Pruritus
fields.description: A chronic or recurrent sensation of itching without a primary skin lesion, often associated with systemic disease, dry skin, or neuropathic conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|7
fields.title: Psoriasis
fields.description: A chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease characterised by scaly erythematous plaques, with systemic associations including psoriatic arthritis.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|8
fields.title: Scabies
fields.description: A highly contagious skin infestation caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei, causing intense pruritus and a characteristic rash, with crusted scabies occurring in immunocompromised individuals.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|9
fields.title: Urticaria
fields.description: An allergic or immune-mediated reaction presenting as transient raised itchy wheals on the skin, often accompanied by angioedema of deeper tissues.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|10
fields.title: Viral skin diseases
fields.description: Skin diseases caused by viral pathogens including herpes simplex virus, human papillomavirus (warts), and molluscum contagiosum.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|11
fields.title: Z_Other skin and subcutaneous diseases
fields.description: Skin and subcutaneous diseases not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories, including rare, unspecified, or miscellaneous dermatological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|0
fields.title: Alcohol use disorders
fields.description: A chronic disorder characterised by compulsive alcohol consumption, loss of control over drinking, and continued use despite physical and social harm.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|1
fields.title: Drug use disorders
fields.description: Disorders characterised by compulsive use of illicit or prescription drugs, including opioids, stimulants, and cannabis, with significant harm to health and functioning.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|2
fields.title: Nicotine dependence
fields.description:
Can you provide a short defintion of nicotine dependence?
12:15

Nicotine dependence is a chronic, relapsing condition characterized by compulsive use of nicotine-containing products (most commonly cigarettes), accompanied by tolerance, a withdrawal syndrome on cessation or reduction, and continued use despite the awareness of harmful consequences.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|0
fields.title: Congenital birth defects
fields.description: Structural or functional abnormalities present at birth, including chromosomal disorders and congenital malformations of the heart, limbs, and other organs.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|1
fields.title: Endocrine, metabolic, blood, and immune disorders
fields.description: A heterogeneous group of conditions affecting endocrine glands, metabolic processes, and immune function, including thyroid disease, adrenal disorders, and autoimmune conditions. Exception is diabetes, which is captured under "Diabetes and kidney diseases" and more specifically under "Diabetes mellitus".

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|2
fields.title: Gynecological diseases
fields.description: Diseases of the female reproductive system, including endometriosis, uterine fibroids, polycystic ovary syndrome, and pelvic inflammatory disease.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|3
fields.title: Hemoglobinopathies and hemolytic anemias
fields.description: Inherited disorders of haemoglobin structure or synthesis, including sickle cell disease and thalassaemia, causing haemolytic anaemia and multi-organ complications.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|4
fields.title: Oral disorders
fields.description: Conditions affecting the teeth, gums, and oral mucosa, including dental caries, periodontal disease, edentulism, and oral infections.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|5
fields.title: Sudden infant death syndrome
fields.description: The sudden unexpected death of an apparently healthy infant, typically during sleep, for which no cause is identified after thorough post-mortem investigation.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|6
fields.title: Urinary diseases and male infertility
fields.description: Conditions affecting the urinary tract and male reproductive system, including urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and causes of male infertility.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|0
fields.title: Self-harm and interpersonal violence
fields.description: Intentional injuries caused by violence directed at oneself or others, including self-harm, assault, sexual violence, and conflict-related injuries.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|1
fields.title: Transport injuries
fields.description: Injuries sustained in road traffic crashes involving motor vehicles, motorcycles, cyclists, and pedestrians.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|2
fields.title: Unintentional injuries
fields.description: Injuries that occur without intent to cause harm, including falls, drowning, burns, poisonings, and environmental exposures.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|0
fields.title: Conflict and terrorism
fields.description: Injuries and deaths resulting from organised collective violence, including war, armed conflict, and terrorist attacks.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|1
fields.title: Interpersonal violence
fields.description: Physical, sexual, or psychological harm intentionally inflicted by one person on another, including assault, domestic violence, and sexual violence.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|2
fields.title: Police conflict and executions
fields.description: Deaths and injuries resulting from the use of force by law enforcement or state actors, including fatal police encounters and state-sanctioned executions.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|3
fields.title: Self-harm
fields.description: Intentional injury directed at oneself, including suicidal behaviour and non-suicidal self-injury, across a spectrum from ideation to fatal self-inflicted harm.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|0
fields.title: Adverse effects of medical treatment
fields.description: Harm resulting from medical or surgical interventions, including adverse drug reactions, surgical complications, and healthcare-associated infections.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|1
fields.title: Animal contact
fields.description: Injuries caused by contact with animals, including bites, stings, and envenomation from snakes, insects, marine animals, and other wildlife.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|2
fields.title: Drowning
fields.description: Respiratory impairment resulting from submersion or immersion in liquid, including fatal drowning and non-fatal near-drowning events.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|3
fields.title: Electrocution
fields.description: Injury caused by passage of electrical current through the body, including low-voltage electrocution and lightning strike, causing tissue damage, cardiac arrest, and burns.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|4
fields.title: Environmental heat and cold exposure
fields.description: Injuries resulting from exposure to extreme environmental temperatures, including heat stroke, heat exhaustion, hypothermia, and frostbite.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|5
fields.title: Exposure to forces of nature
fields.description: Injuries directly caused by natural forces including earthquakes, floods, storms, landslides, and volcanic eruptions.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|6
fields.title: Exposure to mechanical forces
fields.description: Injuries caused by physical mechanical forces including crushing, cutting, impact, and blast, covering occupational and other unintentional mechanical trauma.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|7
fields.title: Falls
fields.description: Injuries resulting from a person falling from one level to another or on the same level, including fractures, head injuries, and soft tissue trauma.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|8
fields.title: Fire, heat, and hot substances
fields.description: Injuries to the skin and deeper tissues caused by flames, hot surfaces, scalding liquids, or contact with hot substances.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|9
fields.title: Foreign body
fields.description: Injury caused by a foreign object entering the body through ingestion, aspiration, or direct penetration of a body cavity or tissue.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|10
fields.title: Poisonings
fields.description: Injury or death resulting from exposure to toxic substances, including medications, household chemicals, pesticides, and environmental toxins.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|11
fields.title: Z_Other unintentional injuries
fields.description: Unintentional injuries not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories, including other accidental exposures and miscellaneous traumatic events.

fields.name: k_population-age|2

fields.name: k_population-age|3
fields.title: Child (2-12 years)
fields.description: Children aged 2 to 12 years, spanning early childhood through to pre-adolescence, during which physical, cognitive, and social development are particularly sensitive to environmental conditions.

fields.name: k_population-age|4
fields.title: Infant (1-23 months)
fields.description: Children aged 1 to 23 months, a developmental period of rapid growth, nutritional dependency, and heightened susceptibility to infectious disease and environmental exposures.

fields.name: dsny000255_sub|0
fields.title: Adult (19-44 years)
fields.description: Adults aged 19 to 44 years, typically characterised by peak physical capacity, reproductive activity, and workforce participation.

fields.name: dsny000255_sub|1
fields.title: Aged (65 years and older)
fields.description: Individuals aged 65 years and older, a broad group encompassing younger-old and oldest-old adults with increasing prevalence of chronic disease, frailty, and functional decline.

fields.name: dsny000255_sub|2
fields.title: Middle aged (45-64 years)
fields.description: Adults aged 45 to 64 years, a life stage associated with the onset of chronic non-communicable diseases and changing physiological risk profiles.

fields.name: dsny000258_sub|0
fields.title: Aged (65-78 years)
fields.description: Older adults aged 65 to 78 years, often retaining significant functional capacity but with increasing chronic disease burden and growing vulnerability to environmental stressors.

fields.name: dsny000258_sub|1
fields.title: Aged (80 years and older)
fields.description: Individuals aged 80 years and older, the fastest-growing demographic in many populations, with the highest prevalence of frailty, multimorbidity, and vulnerability to adverse health events.

fields.name: dsny000251_sub|0
fields.title: Child (6-12 years)
fields.description: Children aged 6 to 12 years in middle childhood, a period of continued physical growth, cognitive development, and increasing social independence.

fields.name: dsny000251_sub|1
fields.title: Preschool child (2-5 years)
fields.description: Children aged 2 to 5 years in the preschool developmental stage, characterised by rapid brain development, high activity levels, and reliance on caregivers for protection from environmental hazards.

fields.name: dsny000249_sub|0
fields.title: Newborn infant
fields.description: Infants in the first 28 days of life, a critical period of physiological adaptation with high vulnerability to infection, thermal stress, and nutritional insufficiency.

fields.name: k_population-gender-sex|0
fields.title: All genders
fields.description: Studies or data that include individuals of all gender identities or both sexes without stratification, or where findings apply across the full gender spectrum.

fields.name: k_population-gender-sex|1
fields.title: Diverse
fields.description: Individuals whose gender identity or expression differs from the sex assigned at birth, including transgender, non-binary, and other gender-diverse people.

fields.name: k_population-gender-sex|2

fields.name: k_population-gender-sex|3
fields.title: Male
fields.description: Individuals identified as male by biological sex or gender identity, used to stratify health data or describe sex-specific biological and social health determinants.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|0
fields.title: Chronic conditions (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Individuals living with one or more long-term physical health conditions that reduce physiological resilience and increase susceptibility to adverse health outcomes.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|1
fields.title: Disabled (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Individuals with physical, sensory, cognitive, or mental impairments that limit daily functioning and may increase exposure to harm and reduce capacity to respond to environmental or social stressors.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|2
fields.title: Ethnic minorities (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Population groups defined by shared ethnic, cultural, or racial identity that may face structural disadvantage, discrimination, or disproportionate exposure to environmental and social risk factors.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|3
fields.title: Frail elderly (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Older adults with reduced physiological reserve and resilience, characterised by weakness, fatigue, and vulnerability to adverse health outcomes following minor stressors.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|4
fields.title: Indigenous peoples (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Populations with historical, cultural, and territorial ties to lands prior to colonisation, who often face compounded social, economic, and environmental vulnerabilities.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|5
fields.title: Infants / children (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Young children and infants whose immature physiological systems, developmental dependency, and limited autonomy increase their susceptibility to environmental exposures and health harms.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|6
fields.title: Low-income (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Individuals and households with insufficient financial resources to meet basic needs, facing compounded vulnerability through reduced access to healthcare, nutrition, safe housing, and adaptive capacity.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|7
fields.title: Migrants (Vulnerability)
fields.description: People who have moved within or across borders, voluntarily or under duress, and who may face elevated health risks due to displacement, poor living conditions, and restricted access to services.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|8
fields.title: Occupation-based (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Individuals whose occupation exposes them to elevated health hazards, including outdoor workers in agriculture, construction, and other sectors with high physical exposure to environmental conditions.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|9
fields.title: Pregnancy (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Individuals during pregnancy, whose altered physiology and increased metabolic demands heighten susceptibility to environmental exposures and infectious disease with potential consequences for both maternal and foetal health.

fields.name: k_population-vulnerability|10
fields.title: Women (Vulnerability)
fields.description: Women as a population group who may face heightened vulnerability due to biological factors, gender-based inequalities in resource access, and higher exposure to specific social and economic risks.

fields.name: k_reference-type|0
fields.title: Article (academic journal)
fields.description: A peer-reviewed research output published in an academic journal, including full research articles, letters to the editor, commentaries, and opinion pieces.

fields.name: k_reference-type|1
fields.title: Grey literature
fields.description: Reports published outside the classic editorial route, predominantly by intergovernmental organizations, supra-national organizations, NGOs, governments.

fields.name: k_reference-type|2
fields.title: Planned research/protocols
fields.description: A registered or published research protocol or trials registry record describing a study that is planned or underway but has not yet reported results.

fields.name: k_reference-type|3
fields.title: Preprint/working paper
fields.description: A research manuscript that has been made publicly available prior to formal peer review and journal publication, such as those posted on medRxiv or SSRN.

fields.name: k_reference-type|4
fields.title: Z_Other reference type
fields.description: Publication type recognition to be automated in V2 of repository. Planned concepts: 1. Planned research/protocols, 2. Preprint/working paper 3. Article (academic journal) 4. Grey literature, 5. Other reference type

fields.name: k_methods|0
fields.title: C.1 Primary research
fields.description: Original research studies that collect and analyse data directly, as distinct from evidence syntheses that aggregate findings from existing studies.

fields.name: k_methods|1
fields.title: C.2 Evidence synthesis
fields.description: Research that systematically or narratively aggregates and synthesises findings from multiple primary studies to draw broader conclusions about a topic.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|0
fields.title: Descriptive / single-group designs
fields.description: Study designs that describe characteristics, frequency, or distribution of outcomes in a single group without a comparison group or temporal manipulation.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|1
fields.title: Experimental / group comparison designs
fields.description: Experimental study designs that compare outcomes between an intervention group and one or more control or comparison groups, with or without randomisation.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|2
fields.title: Experimental / single-group designs
fields.description: Experimental study designs in which an intervention is applied to a single group without a concurrent control group, limiting but not eliminating causal inference.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|3
fields.title: Modelling / simulation
fields.description: Study designs using mathematical, statistical, or computational models to simulate real-world systems, project future outcomes, or estimate impacts under defined scenarios.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|4
fields.title: Observational / group comparison designs
fields.description: Observational study designs that compare health outcomes between two or more groups defined by exposure status, without random allocation.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|5
fields.title: Observational / single-group designs
fields.description: Observational study designs that track outcomes over time in a single group without a concurrent comparison group, relying on temporal patterns to infer associations.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|6
fields.title: Qualitative and mixed-methods designs
fields.description: Study designs using qualitative data collection and analysis, or combining qualitative and quantitative approaches, to explore meanings, experiences, and contextual factors.

fields.name: dsny000167_sub|7
fields.title: Z_Other study design
fields.description: Primary research study designs not captured by the specific categories of descriptive, observational, experimental, qualitative, or modelling designs.

fields.name: dsny000515_sub|0
fields.title: Case report / case study
fields.description: A detailed account of a single individual's or unit's exposure, condition, and outcome, used to generate hypotheses or describe novel or rare phenomena.

fields.name: dsny000515_sub|1
fields.title: Case series / descriptive multi-case study
fields.description: A descriptive report of characteristics and outcomes among a series of individuals sharing a common exposure or condition, without a control group.

fields.name: dsny000515_sub|2
fields.title: Cross-sectional / single-round survey
fields.description: A study design that collects data from a population at a single point in time, describing the prevalence of exposures and outcomes without follow-up.

fields.name: dsny000529_sub|0
fields.title: Non-randomised
fields.description: An experimental or quasi-experimental study in which participants are allocated to intervention and comparison groups through a process other than randomisation, using statistical methods to control for confounding.

fields.name: dsny000529_sub|1
fields.title: Quasi-randomised / natural experiment
fields.description: A study in which allocation to intervention and control conditions occurs through a process that approximates randomisation but is not under the investigator's full control, such as policy roll-out or natural variation.

fields.name: dsny000529_sub|2
fields.title: Randomisation unclear
fields.description: An experimental or quasi-experimental study in which the method of allocation to groups is not clearly reported, precluding classification as randomised or non-randomised.

fields.name: dsny000529_sub|3
fields.title: Randomised / RCT
fields.description: An experimental study in which participants are randomly allocated to intervention or control groups, considered the gold standard for evaluating causal effects of interventions.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|0
fields.title: Difference-in-differences
fields.description: A quasi-experimental method comparing the change in outcomes over time between a group exposed to an intervention and an unexposed control group, to estimate causal effects under the parallel trends assumption.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|1
fields.title: Event study
fields.description: A method estimating the effect of an event or intervention by examining outcome trends relative to the timing of the event, often used to test pre-treatment parallel trends and assess dynamic treatment effects.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|2
fields.title: Fixed effects / panel regression
fields.description: A regression approach using repeated observations on the same units over time to control for time-invariant unobserved confounding, including standard fixed effects, panel regression, and adjusted cohort analysis.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|3
fields.title: Instrumental variables
fields.description: A quasi-experimental method using a variable that affects exposure but not the outcome directly (an instrument) to estimate causal effects in the presence of unmeasured confounding.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|4
fields.title: Matched comparison / propensity score matching
fields.description: A method pairing treated and untreated units on observed characteristics or estimated propensity scores to construct a balanced comparison group and reduce confounding bias.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|5
fields.title: Regression discontinuity
fields.description: A quasi-experimental design exploiting a threshold in a continuous assignment variable to estimate causal effects for units just above and below the cutoff, where assignment is effectively random.

fields.name: dsny000532_sub|6
fields.title: Synthetic control
fields.description: A quasi-experimental method constructing a weighted combination of untreated units to serve as a counterfactual for a treated unit, used when only a small number of aggregate units are available.

fields.name: dsny000527_sub|0
fields.title: Single arm trial / single arm experiment
fields.description: An experimental study in which all participants receive the intervention and outcomes are compared to a pre-specified target or historical baseline, without a concurrent control arm.

fields.name: dsny000545_sub|0
fields.title: Computable general equilibrium (CGE) model
fields.description: A macroeconomic modelling approach representing interactions across sectors of an economy to estimate the economy-wide effects of policy changes, including those with health implications.

fields.name: dsny000545_sub|1
fields.title: Integrated assessment model (IAM) / health impact projection
fields.description: A modelling approach linking climate, economic, and social systems to project future health impacts under different emissions or policy scenarios, often at national or global scale.

fields.name: dsny000545_sub|2
fields.title: Microsimulation
fields.description: A modelling approach simulating the behaviour and outcomes of individual units — people, households, or firms — over time to estimate aggregate population-level effects of policies or exposures.

fields.name: dsny000545_sub|3
fields.title: Other climate-related modelling / simulation
fields.description: Climate or environmental modelling and simulation approaches not classified under IAM, CGE, or microsimulation, including downscaled climate models, exposure models, and environmental simulation tools.

fields.name: dsny000545_sub|4
fields.title: Other health-related modelling / simulation
fields.description: Health modelling and simulation approaches not classified under IAM, CGE, or microsimulation, including epidemiological models, disease transmission models, and burden of disease projections.

fields.name: dsny000522_sub|0
fields.title: (Controlled) interrupted time series
fields.description: A time series analysis comparing outcome trends before and after an intervention or exposure in both an intervention group and a concurrent control group, strengthening causal inference over uncontrolled ITS.

fields.name: dsny000522_sub|1
fields.title: Case-control / retrospective matched comparison
fields.description: A study that retrospectively compares individuals with a health outcome (cases) to those without (controls) to identify differences in prior exposure, often using matching to reduce confounding.

fields.name: dsny000522_sub|2
fields.title: Cohort / panel data / longitudinal study
fields.description: A study that follows a defined group of individuals over time, measuring exposures and outcomes prospectively or retrospectively to assess associations and temporal relationships.

fields.name: dsny000522_sub|3
fields.title: Controlled before-after (CBA)
fields.description: A study comparing pre- and post-intervention outcomes in both an intervention group and a non-randomised control group, improving on uncontrolled before-after designs by accounting for secular trends.

fields.name: dsny000519_sub|0
fields.title: (Uncontrolled) interrupted time series
fields.description: A time series analysis of outcome data at multiple time points before and after an intervention or exposure in a single group, without a control series to account for concurrent trends.

fields.name: dsny000519_sub|1
fields.title: Before-after / pre-post study
fields.description: A study that compares outcomes measured in the same group before and after an exposure or intervention, without a concurrent control group.

fields.name: dsny000541_sub|0
fields.title: Ethnographic / interview-based
fields.description: A qualitative research design using immersive fieldwork, participant observation, or in-depth interviews to explore lived experiences, cultural practices, and social contexts.

fields.name: dsny000541_sub|1
fields.title: Focus group
fields.description: A qualitative method collecting data through facilitated group discussion among selected participants, used to explore shared perspectives, norms, and experiences on a defined topic.

fields.name: dsny000541_sub|2
fields.title: Mixed-methods
fields.description: A research design that integrates quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis within a single study, combining the strengths of both approaches to address research questions.

fields.name: dsny000198_sub|0
fields.title: Guideline (clinical or public health)
fields.description: A systematically developed statement providing recommendations to guide clinical or public health practice, typically based on a synthesis of the available evidence. Often with systematic methods, but sometimes also based on expert consensus.

fields.name: dsny000198_sub|1
fields.title: Health technology assessment (HTA)
fields.description: A comprehensive policy-relevant evaluation of a health technology that typically includes clinical effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, and broader social and ethical considerations.

fields.name: dsny000198_sub|2
fields.title: Narrative review
fields.description: A non-systematic review that summarises and interprets the literature on a topic based on the author's expertise and judgement, without exhaustive or reproducible search methods.

fields.name: dsny000198_sub|3
fields.title: Systematic review
fields.description: A review that uses explicit, reproducible methods to systematically search, select, appraise, and synthesise evidence from primary studies on a defined research question.

fields.name: dsny000198_sub|4
fields.title: Umbrella review / overview of reviews
fields.description: A synthesis that systematically compiles and summarises findings from multiple systematic reviews on a related topic, providing a high-level overview of the evidence base.

fields.name: dsny000198_sub|5
fields.title: Z_Other evidence synthesis type
fields.description: Evidence synthesis types not captured by the specific categories of systematic review, umbrella review, narrative review, guideline, or health technology assessment.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|0
fields.title: Evidence map / evidence gap map
fields.description: A systematic mapping exercise that visually represents the distribution of evidence across a framework of interventions and outcomes, highlighting areas where evidence is absent or weak.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|1
fields.title: Full systematic review
fields.description: A systematic review conducted with comprehensive search strategies and full methodological rigour, without time or resource constraints that would limit its scope.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|2
fields.title: Mixed-methods review
fields.description: A systematic review that integrates findings from both quantitative and qualitative primary studies, using mixed-methods synthesis approaches to address questions that neither approach could answer alone.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|3
fields.title: Qualitative evidence synthesis
fields.description: A systematic review that searches for, appraises, and synthesises findings from qualitative primary studies, using methods such as meta-ethnography, thematic synthesis, or framework synthesis.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|4
fields.title: Rapid review
fields.description: A systematic review conducted within a shortened timeframe using streamlined methods, trading some comprehensiveness for speed to meet urgent policy or practice needs.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|5
fields.title: Realist review
fields.description: A theory-driven review methodology that explores how and why interventions work in particular contexts and for whom, generating or testing explanatory theories rather than aggregating effect estimates.

fields.name: dsny000201_sub|6
fields.title: Scoping review
fields.description: A systematic review that maps the extent, range, and nature of evidence on a broad topic without synthesising findings, used to identify gaps and inform future research priorities.

fields.name: k_topic|0
fields.title: Adaptation
fields.description: Adjustments in natural or human systems in response to actual or anticipated climate change, intended to moderate harm or exploit beneficial opportunities arising from climate variability.

fields.name: k_topic|1
fields.title: Impact
fields.description: The effects of climate change on natural and human systems, including consequences for health, ecosystems, economies, and societies resulting from climate variability and change.

fields.name: k_topic|2
fields.title: Mitigation
fields.description: Actions and strategies aimed at reducing or preventing greenhouse gas emissions in order to limit the magnitude of future climate change and its associated health and environmental impacts.

fields.name: dsny000052_sub|0
fields.title: Maladaptation
fields.description: Adaptation actions that inadvertently increase vulnerability or exposure to harm, reduce adaptive capacity, or create new risks for human or natural systems, often as an unintended consequence of well-intentioned interventions.

fields.name: dsny000053_sub|0
fields.title: Attribution
fields.description: The process of establishing the causal contribution of climate change to observed changes in physical, ecological, or human systems, including specific extreme weather events or health outcomes.

fields.name: dsny000053_sub|1
fields.title: Future impact
fields.description: Projected effects on human health, ecosystems, and societies arising from anticipated changes in climate over coming decades, typically derived from climate modelling and scenario analysis.

fields.name: dsny000053_sub|2
fields.title: Loss and damage
fields.description: Negative consequences of climate change that cannot be avoided through mitigation or adaptation, including irreversible harm to lives, livelihoods, cultural heritage, ecosystems, and infrastructure.

fields.name: dsny000051_sub|0
fields.title: Co-Benefits
fields.description: Positive health, social, or environmental benefits arising from mitigation actions that are additional to the primary goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, such as improved air quality or increased physical activity.

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|0
fields.title: (Unspecified) changes in weather
fields.description: General changes in weather patterns not attributed to a specific meteorological variable, used when studies refer to weather variability in broad terms.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|1
fields.title: (Unspecified) climate change
fields.description: Climate change where the specific driver or mechanism is not identified or distinguished, used when studies refer to climate change in general terms.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|2
fields.title: Changes in glacier / snow melt
fields.description: Accelerated melting of glaciers and snowpack due to rising temperatures, affecting freshwater supply, sea levels, and downstream ecosystems.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|3
fields.title: Changes in humidity
fields.description: Shifts in atmospheric moisture levels that affect thermal comfort, respiratory health, and the prevalence of moisture-related diseases.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|4
fields.title: Changes in precipitation
fields.description: Alterations in the amount, timing, or intensity of rainfall and snowfall, affecting water availability, flood risk, and drought conditions.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|5
fields.title: Changes in sea level
fields.description: The increase in mean sea level resulting from thermal expansion of seawater and melting ice, threatening coastal communities, infrastructure, and freshwater resources.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|6
fields.title: Changes in season length
fields.description: Shifts in the duration of seasons, including earlier spring onset and extended summers, with consequences for agriculture, vector biology, and human health.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|7
fields.title: Changes in temperature
fields.description: Long-term shifts in average or extreme temperature conditions, including warming trends, that affect human health, ecosystems, and society.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|8
fields.title: Changes in wind speed
fields.description: Alterations in wind patterns and velocity that can affect air quality, energy systems, and the spread of airborne pathogens and pollutants.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_climate-drivers-variability|9
fields.title: Climate variability
fields.description: Climate variability refers to fluctuations in climate conditions (temperature, precipitation, wind patterns, etc.) over months, years, or decades around a longer-term average. Climate variability is influenced by multiple climate drivers.
fields.scheme_name: E.1 Climate factors - Climate drivers / variability

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|0
fields.title: (Unspecified) extreme weather events
fields.description: Extreme weather events where the specific type is not identified, used when studies refer to climate extremes without distinguishing between event types.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|1
fields.title: Droughts
fields.description: Prolonged periods of abnormally low rainfall leading to water scarcity, crop failure, and increased risk of wildfires, with significant health and livelihood consequences.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|2
fields.title: Extreme cold
fields.description: Episodes of abnormally low temperatures, including cold snaps and blizzards, associated with increased risk of hypothermia, cardiovascular events, and respiratory illness.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|3
fields.title: Extreme heat
fields.description: Periods of abnormally high temperatures, including heatwaves, that pose direct health risks such as heat exhaustion, heat stroke, and excess mortality.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|4
fields.title: Floods
fields.description: Temporary inundation of normally dry land caused by excessive rainfall, storm surges, or rapid snowmelt, posing risks to human health, displacement, and infrastructure.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|5
fields.title: Storms
fields.description: Intense meteorological events including tropical cyclones, hurricanes, typhoons, and severe thunderstorms, causing wind damage, flooding, and displacement.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_extreme-weather-events|6
fields.title: Wildfires
fields.description: Uncontrolled fires in natural vegetation, increasingly associated with drought and heat, producing smoke and air pollution with severe respiratory and cardiovascular health impacts.
fields.scheme_name: E.2 Climate factors - Extreme weather events

fields.name: k_climate-forcing-agents|0
fields.title: (Unspecified) greenhouse gases
fields.description: Atmospheric gases that trap heat and contribute to the greenhouse effect, referred to collectively without specifying the individual gas type.
fields.scheme_name: E.3 Climate factors - Climate forcing agents

fields.name: k_climate-forcing-agents|1
fields.title: Carbon dioxide (CO₂)
