fields.description: Protrusion of abdominal contents through a weakness in the abdominal wall, including inguinal, femoral, and other hernias requiring surgical repair.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|5
fields.title: Pancreatitis
fields.description: Acute or chronic inflammation of the pancreas, causing abdominal pain and disrupting digestive enzyme and insulin secretion.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|6
fields.title: Paralytic ileus and intestinal obstruction
fields.description: Mechanical or functional obstruction of the intestine causing failure of intestinal transit, presenting with pain, distension, and vomiting.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|7
fields.title: Upper digestive system diseases
fields.description: Diseases affecting the oesophagus, stomach, and duodenum, including peptic ulcer disease, gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, and gastritis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|8
fields.title: Vascular intestinal disorders
fields.description: Conditions arising from impaired blood supply to the intestinal wall, including mesenteric ischaemia and ischaemic colitis.

fields.name: dsny000404_sub|9
fields.title: Z_Other digestive diseases
fields.description: Digestive diseases not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories of liver, upper GI, appendix, hernia, IBD, vascular, gallbladder, or pancreatic disease.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|0
fields.title: Anxiety disorders
fields.description: A group of mental disorders characterised by excessive fear or worry disproportionate to circumstances, including generalised anxiety disorder, panic disorder, and phobias.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|1
fields.title: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
fields.description: A neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by persistent inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that impairs functioning across multiple settings.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|2
fields.title: Autism spectrum disorders
fields.description: A neurodevelopmental condition characterised by persistent difficulties in social communication and interaction alongside restricted, repetitive patterns of behaviour.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|3
fields.title: Bipolar disorder
fields.description: A mood disorder characterised by episodes of mania or hypomania alternating with depression, causing significant disruption to functioning and quality of life.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|4
fields.title: Conduct disorder
fields.description: A disruptive behavioural disorder characterised by repetitive and persistent patterns of antisocial behaviour, aggression, or violation of social norms.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|5
fields.title: Depressive disorders
fields.description: A common mental disorder characterised by persistent low mood, anhedonia, and a range of cognitive, physical, and emotional symptoms causing significant functional impairment.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|6
fields.title: Eating disorders
fields.description: Mental disorders characterised by abnormal eating behaviours and distorted body image, including anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge eating disorder.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|7
fields.title: Idiopathic developmental intellectual disability
fields.description: Significantly impaired intellectual functioning and adaptive behaviour arising from neurodevelopmental causes, without an identifiable acquired or genetic aetiology.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|8
fields.title: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
fields.description: A trauma- and stressor-related disorder developing after exposure to actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence, characterised by intrusive symptoms, avoidance, and hyperarousal.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|9
fields.title: Schizophrenia
fields.description: A severe chronic mental disorder characterised by positive symptoms (hallucinations, delusions), negative symptoms (blunted affect, social withdrawal), and cognitive impairment.

fields.name: dsny000423_sub|10
fields.title: Z_Other mental disorders
fields.description: Mental disorders not classified under the major GBD mental health sub-categories, including other anxiety, dissociative, somatic, and unspecified psychiatric conditions.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|0
fields.title: Malignant skin melanoma
fields.description: A malignant tumour arising from melanocytes in the skin, strongly associated with ultraviolet radiation exposure and with high metastatic potential.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|1
fields.title: Non-melanoma skin cancer
fields.description: Malignant tumours arising from keratinocytes in the skin, including basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, associated with cumulative UV radiation exposure.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|2
fields.title: Tracheal, bronchus, and lung cancer
fields.description: Malignant tumours arising in the trachea, bronchi, or lung parenchyma, strongly associated with tobacco smoking and air pollution exposure.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|3
fields.title: Z_Other malignant neoplasms
fields.description: Malignant neoplasms not classified under the specific GBD cancer sub-categories, spanning other primary tumour sites and histological types.

fields.name: dsny000378_sub|4
fields.title: Z_Other neoplasms
fields.description: Non-malignant tumours that do not invade surrounding tissue or metastasise but may cause local symptoms through mass effect.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|0
fields.title: Alzheimer's disease and other dementias
fields.description: Progressive neurodegenerative diseases characterised by cognitive decline, including Alzheimer's disease and other dementias causing loss of memory, reasoning, and functional independence.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|1
fields.title: Headache disorders
fields.description: Chronic neurological disorders characterised by recurrent headache, including migraine, tension-type headache, and cluster headache, causing significant disability.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|2
fields.title: Idiopathic epilepsy
fields.description: A neurological disorder characterised by recurrent unprovoked seizures due to abnormal electrical activity in the brain, not attributable to an identified structural or metabolic cause.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|3
fields.title: Motor neuron disease
fields.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disease causing degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons, leading to progressive paralysis and respiratory failure.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|4
fields.title: Multiple sclerosis
fields.description: A chronic autoimmune demyelinating disease of the central nervous system, characterised by relapsing or progressive neurological deficits affecting motor, sensory, and cognitive function.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|5
fields.title: Parkinson's disease
fields.description: A progressive neurodegenerative disease characterised by tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia, and postural instability, caused by loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra.

fields.name: dsny000415_sub|6
fields.title: Z_Other neurological disorders
fields.description: Neurological conditions not classified under the major GBD neurological sub-categories, including rare and unspecified disorders of the nervous system.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|0
fields.title: Age-related and other hearing loss
fields.description: Partial or complete loss of hearing attributable to ageing, noise exposure, ototoxic medications, or other causes, affecting communication and quality of life.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|1
fields.title: Blindness and vision loss
fields.description: A spectrum of visual impairment ranging from reduced vision to complete blindness, caused by refractive errors, cataracts, glaucoma, macular degeneration, and infectious causes including trachoma.

fields.name: dsny000457_sub|2
fields.title: Other sense organ diseases
fields.description: Sense organ diseases not classified under blindness and vision loss or hearing loss, including other ocular and otological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|0
fields.title: Acne vulgaris
fields.description: A chronic inflammatory disease of the pilosebaceous unit characterised by comedones, papules, pustules, and nodules, predominantly affecting the face and trunk.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|1
fields.title: Alopecia areata
fields.description: An autoimmune condition causing patchy non-scarring hair loss on the scalp or other hair-bearing areas, which may progress to total hair loss.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|2
fields.title: Bacterial skin diseases
fields.description: Bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissue, including cellulitis, impetigo, and erysipelas, caused predominantly by Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pyogenes.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|3
fields.title: Decubitus ulcer
fields.description: Localised skin and underlying tissue injury resulting from prolonged pressure or shear forces, typically over bony prominences in immobile patients.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|4
fields.title: Dermatitis
fields.description: Inflammatory skin conditions characterised by erythema, pruritus, and scaling, including atopic dermatitis and contact dermatitis.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|5
fields.title: Fungal skin diseases
fields.description: Skin infections caused by fungi including dermatophytes (tinea), yeasts (candidiasis), and moulds, particularly prevalent in hot and humid conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|6
fields.title: Pruritus
fields.description: A chronic or recurrent sensation of itching without a primary skin lesion, often associated with systemic disease, dry skin, or neuropathic conditions.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|7
fields.title: Psoriasis
fields.description: A chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease characterised by scaly erythematous plaques, with systemic associations including psoriatic arthritis.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|8
fields.title: Scabies
fields.description: A highly contagious skin infestation caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei, causing intense pruritus and a characteristic rash, with crusted scabies occurring in immunocompromised individuals.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|9
fields.title: Urticaria
fields.description: An allergic or immune-mediated reaction presenting as transient raised itchy wheals on the skin, often accompanied by angioedema of deeper tissues.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|10
fields.title: Viral skin diseases
fields.description: Skin diseases caused by viral pathogens including herpes simplex virus, human papillomavirus (warts), and molluscum contagiosum.

fields.name: dsny000444_sub|11
fields.title: Z_Other skin and subcutaneous diseases
fields.description: Skin and subcutaneous diseases not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories, including rare, unspecified, or miscellaneous dermatological conditions.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|0
fields.title: Alcohol use disorders
fields.description: A chronic disorder characterised by compulsive alcohol consumption, loss of control over drinking, and continued use despite physical and social harm.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|1
fields.title: Drug use disorders
fields.description: Disorders characterised by compulsive use of illicit or prescription drugs, including opioids, stimulants, and cannabis, with significant harm to health and functioning.

fields.name: dsny000435_sub|2
fields.title: Nicotine dependence
fields.description:
Can you provide a short defintion of nicotine dependence?
12:15

Nicotine dependence is a chronic, relapsing condition characterized by compulsive use of nicotine-containing products (most commonly cigarettes), accompanied by tolerance, a withdrawal syndrome on cessation or reduction, and continued use despite the awareness of harmful consequences.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|0
fields.title: Congenital birth defects
fields.description: Structural or functional abnormalities present at birth, including chromosomal disorders and congenital malformations of the heart, limbs, and other organs.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|1
fields.title: Endocrine, metabolic, blood, and immune disorders
fields.description: A heterogeneous group of conditions affecting endocrine glands, metabolic processes, and immune function, including thyroid disease, adrenal disorders, and autoimmune conditions. Exception is diabetes, which is captured under "Diabetes and kidney diseases" and more specifically under "Diabetes mellitus".

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|2
fields.title: Gynecological diseases
fields.description: Diseases of the female reproductive system, including endometriosis, uterine fibroids, polycystic ovary syndrome, and pelvic inflammatory disease.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|3
fields.title: Hemoglobinopathies and hemolytic anemias
fields.description: Inherited disorders of haemoglobin structure or synthesis, including sickle cell disease and thalassaemia, causing haemolytic anaemia and multi-organ complications.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|4
fields.title: Oral disorders
fields.description: Conditions affecting the teeth, gums, and oral mucosa, including dental caries, periodontal disease, edentulism, and oral infections.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|5
fields.title: Sudden infant death syndrome
fields.description: The sudden unexpected death of an apparently healthy infant, typically during sleep, for which no cause is identified after thorough post-mortem investigation.

fields.name: dsny000462_sub|6
fields.title: Urinary diseases and male infertility
fields.description: Conditions affecting the urinary tract and male reproductive system, including urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and causes of male infertility.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|0
fields.title: Self-harm and interpersonal violence
fields.description: Intentional injuries caused by violence directed at oneself or others, including self-harm, assault, sexual violence, and conflict-related injuries.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|1
fields.title: Transport injuries
fields.description: Injuries sustained in road traffic crashes involving motor vehicles, motorcycles, cyclists, and pedestrians.

fields.name: dsny000470_sub|2
fields.title: Unintentional injuries
fields.description: Injuries that occur without intent to cause harm, including falls, drowning, burns, poisonings, and environmental exposures.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|0
fields.title: Conflict and terrorism
fields.description: Injuries and deaths resulting from organised collective violence, including war, armed conflict, and terrorist attacks.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|1
fields.title: Interpersonal violence
fields.description: Physical, sexual, or psychological harm intentionally inflicted by one person on another, including assault, domestic violence, and sexual violence.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|2
fields.title: Police conflict and executions
fields.description: Deaths and injuries resulting from the use of force by law enforcement or state actors, including fatal police encounters and state-sanctioned executions.

fields.name: dsny000485_sub|3
fields.title: Self-harm
fields.description: Intentional injury directed at oneself, including suicidal behaviour and non-suicidal self-injury, across a spectrum from ideation to fatal self-inflicted harm.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|0
fields.title: Adverse effects of medical treatment
fields.description: Harm resulting from medical or surgical interventions, including adverse drug reactions, surgical complications, and healthcare-associated infections.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|1
fields.title: Animal contact
fields.description: Injuries caused by contact with animals, including bites, stings, and envenomation from snakes, insects, marine animals, and other wildlife.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|2
fields.title: Drowning
fields.description: Respiratory impairment resulting from submersion or immersion in liquid, including fatal drowning and non-fatal near-drowning events.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|3
fields.title: Electrocution
fields.description: Injury caused by passage of electrical current through the body, including low-voltage electrocution and lightning strike, causing tissue damage, cardiac arrest, and burns.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|4
fields.title: Environmental heat and cold exposure
fields.description: Injuries resulting from exposure to extreme environmental temperatures, including heat stroke, heat exhaustion, hypothermia, and frostbite.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|5
fields.title: Exposure to forces of nature
fields.description: Injuries directly caused by natural forces including earthquakes, floods, storms, landslides, and volcanic eruptions.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|6
fields.title: Exposure to mechanical forces
fields.description: Injuries caused by physical mechanical forces including crushing, cutting, impact, and blast, covering occupational and other unintentional mechanical trauma.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|7
fields.title: Falls
fields.description: Injuries resulting from a person falling from one level to another or on the same level, including fractures, head injuries, and soft tissue trauma.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|8
fields.title: Fire, heat, and hot substances
fields.description: Injuries to the skin and deeper tissues caused by flames, hot surfaces, scalding liquids, or contact with hot substances.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|9
fields.title: Foreign body
fields.description: Injury caused by a foreign object entering the body through ingestion, aspiration, or direct penetration of a body cavity or tissue.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|10
fields.title: Poisonings
fields.description: Injury or death resulting from exposure to toxic substances, including medications, household chemicals, pesticides, and environmental toxins.

fields.name: dsny000472_sub|11
fields.title: Z_Other unintentional injuries
fields.description: Unintentional injuries not classified under the specific GBD sub-categories, including other accidental exposures and miscellaneous traumatic events.
